title: Microsoft Agent 365: control plane to observe, govern and secure agents
notes: claim 84: severity blocker on a rationale: risk rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: Hold: Microsoft documents automation for user access, permitted publisher types and MCP server packages that this briefing reports as undocumented. It also overstates registry coverage and incorrectly says every control must be set by an administrator, despite Microsoft's documentation of automatically enabled policies.

claims.fix: Replace controls[3].api null with graph 'POST https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/copilot/admin/catalog/packages/{id}/block', docs https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/copilot/extensibility/api/admin-settings/package/copilotpackage-block. Qualify its note: 'Preview package-level block for an MCP server represented as a catalog package; requires Agent 365 and delegated CopilotPackages.ReadWrite.All. Do not equate this with revoking credentials or assume it configures every gateway or connected component.' The package-to-MCP applicability is documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/copilot/extensibility/api/admin-settings/package/overview, already cited. Remove the blanket assertion that every row except agent blocking is admin-centre-only.

claims.where: Governance guidance: At rollout and After rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: The governance checklist asks readers to govern individual tools and review spending limits, but neither has a corresponding control row.
